title: Gosipụta ọkọlọtọ gị: ngwugwu ndị na-azụ ahịa, ọzụzụ na nyocha

say: Gosipụta ọkọlọtọ gị: ngwugwu ndị na-azụ ahịa, ọzụzụ na nyocha.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul atọ nke Product Standardization and Compliance.
Mgbe nnukwu ụlọ ahịa ma ọ bụ ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na-atụle onye na-ebubata ihe ọhụrụ, onye na-azụ ya aghaghị ime ka onye njikwa ya kwenye. Akwụkwọ doro anya na-eme ka ọrụ ya dị mfe.

say: Debe mkpọ a ka PDF na ekwentị gị. Mpempe akwụkwọ data na-achịkọta ụdịdị gị maka ndị na-azụ ahịa. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Funmi na-atụ otu ite jupụtara na gram 160. ite 24 tinyere katọn gram 300 na-enye gram 4,140, ​​ihe dị ka kilogram 4.1.
Ziga nnomi nwere akara mmiri, ọ nweghị nke izizi.

rows: Ihe nlere anya shelf na akara edobere

say: Ugbu a wuo mkpọ onye zụrụ gị wee malite igbe nlele edobere. Mee matriks nka nka ma gosipụta iwu nkwụsị gị. Wee mee nyocha gị wee dee atụmatụ ụbọchị 90 gị site na iji otu ebumnuche enwere ike tụọ ya.
Gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
